propositions: Five test cases have assertions that logically cannot fail: the PAT test constructs a transport that never receives a PAT; the pagination guard test reimplements the AST walk inline instead of calling the shared predicate; the assignee-exists test only asserts method presence rather than return value; the rate-limit test uses <= instead of == allowing zero client calls; the backend test only checks class relationships not raising behavior
Each vacuous test carries a docstring promising a real contract (credential leakage, guard behavior, return-value identity, retry logic, exception type) that the body never actually verifies
The PAT repr test must be rewritten to construct a transport that carries a credential and assert the credential does not appear in repr() output

The pagination guard teeth test must call the shared _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() helper (parameterized with an optional source argument) against synthetic unpaginated code rather than reimplementing the AST walk
The assignee-exists test must call validate_assignee_exists and assert the return value is a username string for both DC and Cloud backends, not merely that the method exists
The rate-limit sweep must assert exactly one client call per member (total == 1 not <=) and replace blanket Exception handling with specific BackendHTTPError with .code == 429 assertion per member
